Neugebauer, the co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., has issued a statement in response to the company's decision to drop its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment. Neugebauer's claims challenging the validity of the bylaw remain alive and he will continue to pursue discovery and depositions of key players.

general.title: Senegal to Negotiate a Debt Reprofiling in Talks With Creditors
general.summary: Senegal will seek to negotiate a debt reprofiling instead of a restructuring in talks with creditors as the West African nation moves to make its loans sustainable to qualify for an International Monetary Fund program.

general.title: Qualcomm Signs Deal to Provide Amazon With Custom AI Chips
general.summary: Qualcomm Inc., the largest maker of smartphone processors, said it’s signed up Amazon.com Inc. as a data center chip customer in a deal that will span “multiple generations” and gives Amazon the right to acquire as much as $4 billion in shares.

general.title: CME Strikes Deal to Enter European Dairy Futures Market
general.summary: CME Group, the world’s biggest derivatives exchange, is expanding into the European dairy market as growing consumer demand for protein-rich foods fuels investor interest in the sector.

general.title: US-Canada Trade War Has Small Businesses Struggling With Tariff Shock
general.summary: Across Canada, companies are losing orders, contemplating job cuts and paying higher costs

general.title: Xi Urges UK to Protect Chinese Investors in Call With Burnham
general.summary: China’s President Xi Jinping urged Britain to protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese investors in his first phone call with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, saying the two countries’ common interests outweigh their differences.

general.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro participam de eventos no 7 de setembro em meio à crise no STF
general.summary: Mariana Lumy e Daniel Carvalho acompanharam o presidente Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro em eventos no 7 de setembro, em meio à crise no STF. Edição de Patricia Xavier. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Oil Tanker Company Says It’s Owed $55 Million in Rate Dispute
general.summary: Oil tanker company Hunter Group ASA says it’s owed $55 million by a counterparty that’s disputing its contractual obligations after a surge in the world’s benchmark freight rate.

general.title: Trump says he's made 'Hundreds of Billions of Dollars on Stocks' for the U.S., in stream of AI posts
general.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a stream of AI-generated images and a series of sweeping and unverified claims on Truth Social on Sunday

general.title: Nuclear Firm HGP Plans SPAC Deal at $1.2 Billion Value
general.summary: HGP Intelligent Energy plans to go public via a blank-check vehicle in a deal valuing the nuclear services firm at about $1.2 billion, according to a statement from the company on Tuesday.

general.title: A Labor Day gas record, Amazon's deadly jet crash, the rise of the CISO and more in Morning Squawk
general.summary: Here are five key things investors need to know to start the trading day.

general.title: Xerox Shareholder Pushes for Activist Changes at Company
general.summary: A significant shareholder in Xerox Holdings Corp. is pushing the company to take action to unlock shareholder value and is asking for a strategic review of its financial services business.

general.title: European SpaceX Rival Raises $450 Million to Build Rocket Engine
general.summary: The Exploration Company Gmbh has raised $450 million in funding to help boost the development of Europe’s first reusable space capsule and a new rocket engine, which the SpaceX rival has said would be the largest in the region.

general.title: Apple’s $2,000-Plus Foldable iPhone Was a Decade in the Making
general.summary: Around 2020, Apple Inc. Chief Executive Officer Tim Cook returned from a trip to Asia unusually energized about a new product category: foldable phones.

general.title: Meta Ran Hundreds of Ads Showing AI Child Sexual Abuse, NGO Says
general.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. has run more than 300 advertisements on Instagram and Facebook containing suspected child sexual abuse material this year, according to a report Tuesday by the nonprofit Tech Transparency Project.

general.title: Buyout Debt Worth $138 Billion Set to Land in Credit Markets
general.summary: Credit investors look set to be spoiled for choice as bankers gear up to offload in excess of $138 billion of buyout debt in coming months.

general.title: China’s trade surplus
general.summary: Concerns are mounting in Washington and Brussels that China’s export surge is unsustainable

general.title: Healey Says UK Borrowing ‘Too High’ in Signal of Fiscal Rigor
general.summary: UK borrowing is still too high and growth is still fragile, Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey told the House of Commons on Tuesday as he faced calls to rule out tax rises at next month’s budget.

general.title: Chile Inflation Comes in Above Expectations Before Rate Decision
general.summary: Chile consumer prices rose much more than forecast last month on a jump in food and transportation costs, according to a report published just as central bankers meet to set their benchmark interest rate.

general.title: School Students Who Use AI Get Worse Test Scores, OECD Warns
general.summary: Students who do not use AI chatbots for schoolwork are outperforming those who do, according to the OECD’s flagship educational report, providing some of the widest-ranging evidence yet that the technology could be hurting children’s learning.

general.title: SK Hynix and Smilegate Leaders May Have to Sell Assets to Settle Divorce Cases
general.summary: Marriage breakups get complicated with multibillion-dollar ventures on the line

general.title: SpaceX Shares to Get a Boost If Nasdaq 100 Increases Weighting
general.summary: SpaceX’s stock has been stuck in a tight trading range recently, but a wave of new buying may soon arrive when the Nasdaq 100 Index goes through its quarterly rebalancing later this month.

general.title: AI Health Company Forus Raises $150 Million at a $3 Billion Value
general.summary: Healthcare automation startup Forus has raised $150 million at a $3 billion valuation just months after completing a previous funding round. The Series C round was led by Bain Capital Ventures, a firm that has invested in the company since its early-stage funding. Accel, Thrive Capital, General Catalyst, Redpoint Ventures, BoxGroup and Pear VC also participated in the round, Forus said Tuesday.

general.title: Germany Latest: Political Earthquake Tests Merz’s Economic Recovery
general.summary: An electoral earthquake just hit Berlin, but will it hurt the wider economy?

general.title: Farmers Are Embracing AI More Than Any Other Tech, McKinsey Says
general.summary: Artificial intelligence use is surging on farms as growers look for some high-tech help in planning and managing operations after years of scaling back on spending, according to McKinsey & Co.

general.title: Bluecore Energy Raises $50 Million for Maritime Nuclear System
general.summary: A Southern California startup with plans to deploy floating nuclear power plants may be one step closer to providing electricity to the busiest seaport complex in the US.

general.title: Hungary’s Deficit Swells to $16.5 Billion on EU Fund Prepayments
general.summary: Hungary posted a jump in its budget deficit in August as the restart of European Union funding after Viktor Orban’s ouster this year left the new government with a heavy bill of prepayments to unlock the aid.

general.title: Boston Scientific Warns of Financial Hit from Cyber Attack
general.summary: Boston Scientific Corp. said the fallout from a cyber attack has impacted its ability to ship its products to customers and will cause the medical devices company to miss its sales growth and earnings estimates for the year.

general.title: Amazon Hires Banks for Debut Sterling Bond Sale
general.summary: Amazon.com mandated banks for a debut sterling bond offering, with the deal expected to launch as soon as Wednesday. The company plans to offer tranches ranging from three years to 19 years. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: US Earnings Upgrades Are on Their Longest Run in Five Years
general.summary: A robust outlook for Corporate America is helping underpin US stocks as inflation risks mount.

general.title: Chile Set to Hold Rates as Fed Risk Overshadows Growth Slump
general.summary: Chile’s economic activity is languishing, unemployment is at the highest level since the pandemic lockdowns and 2026 growth forecasts are in free-fall. And yet the central bank is widely expected to hold interest rates steady on Tuesday as inflation risks mount.

general.title: Dyson’s AI Toothbrush Shows How Weird Smart Gadgets Are Becoming
general.summary: The wearable industry is giving itself an AI makeover that it hopes you like and trust

general.title: Thailand Seeks 10,000 Sri Lankan Workers After Cambodia Exodus
general.summary: Thailand plans to recruit about 10,000 workers from Sri Lanka, marking its first large-scale push beyond neighboring countries for migrant labor after border tensions drove many Cambodian workers home.
